property_summary: After any interaction, pastBlockTime must equal the block.timestamp of the most recent previous interaction that updated it, so that the next call's require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime) enforces strictly increasing timestamps; the buggy version updates pastBlockTime before the check, allowing the same block timestamp to pass the require.
change_summary: Move pastBlockTime = block.timestamp before require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime), causing the require to always pass on the same block timestamp.
